SELECT 'leadershipSkills' AS field, cards.leadershipSkills AS value, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM cards
WHERE cards.leadershipSkills IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cards.leadershipSkills
UNION ALL
SELECT 'types', cards.types, COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE cards.types LIKE '%Creature%'
GROUP BY cards.types
UNION ALL
SELECT 'isPromo', CAST(cards.isPromo AS TEXT), COUNT(*)
FROM cards
GROUP BY cards.isPromo
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Brawl legality', legalities.format || '/' || legalities.status, COUNT(*)
FROM legalities
WHERE legalities.format LIKE '%brawl%'
GROUP BY legalities.format, legalities.status

arguments.sql:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT cards.name, cards.scryfallOracleId, cards.uuid, cards.isPromo
    FROM cards
    WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
      AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
),
promo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cards.name FROM cards WHERE cards.isPromo = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT eligible.name) AS eligible_names,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eligible.isPromo = 1 THEN eligible.name END) AS same_row,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS any_promo,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL THEN eligible.scryfallOracleId END) AS promo_oracle_ids,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND eligible.scryfallOracleId IS NULL THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_names_missing_oracle_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Legal' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_legal,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN promo.name IS NOT NULL AND legalities.status = 'Banned' THEN eligible.name END) AS promo_and_banned
FROM eligible
LEFT JOIN promo ON promo.name = eligible.name
LEFT JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = eligible.uuid AND legalities.format = 'brawl'

SELECT cards.name, cards.types, cards.side,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT legalities.status) AS brawl_statuses,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cards.uuid) AS eligible_printings
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid AND legalities.format = 'brawl'
WHERE instr(',' || cards.types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND instr(cards.leadershipSkills, '''brawl'': True') > 0
  AND cards.name IN (SELECT cards.name FROM cards WHERE cards.isPromo = 1)
GROUP BY cards.name, cards.types, cards.side
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN legalities.status = 'Banned' THEN 1 END) > 0 OR cards.side IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cards.name, cards.side
